JURJANI-ASRAR (author): Ibn al-Rumi compares farewell tears flowing onto a cheek to dew dripping from narcissus onto a rose. JURJANI-ASRAR (author): Al-Buhturi reverses the image, comparing dew carried by anemones to the tears of young women on their cheeks. JURJANI-ASRAR (author): A further comparison likens an old man bent by age, with his head sunk between his shoulders, to a fledgling.
